punchline: The Dalai Lama and Tutu split joy into eight pillars, four of the mind and four of the heart.
thirty_sec: In The Book of Joy, the Dalai Lama and Desmond Tutu name eight pillars of joy. Four are of the mind: perspective, humility, humor, acceptance. Four are of the heart: forgiveness, gratitude, compassion, generosity. A takeaway from the book is that joy comes from not dwelling too much on yourself.
